line: School menu slot audit: how the 'plant protein at least twice a week' rule is filled today, by what, at what cost
method: Collect published two-week menus from 40 to 60 schools in five provinces (Hanoi, HCMC, Son La, Dien Bien, Khanh Hoa); code each protein dish (source, grams, cost); three calls to DOETs or caterers for costs; check the Ajinomoto menu software recipe list
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: If schools already buy chay mock meat or textured soy for the plant days, schools become an existing plant-protein buyer and move from 'not first' to a second route for TPP-01 and TPP-02; if the plant days are tofu only at VND 20,000 to 30,000 per 100 g protein, that price becomes the ceiling for any school product
conclusion_or_recommendation_affected: ch25.3 and ch25.6 channel table; channel_ranking.csv; TPP-04; DMV-17

line: Public-meal rule window: track and feed the Food Safety Law, the school-nutrition rule, the unified national menu and shift-meal guidance
method: Desk tracking of drafts (NA portal, MOH and MOET consultations); two calls (MOH Department of Disease Prevention; MOET Department of Students); a short technical note offered to drafters
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: If the school rule or unified menu limits all processed protein foods, blends and textured products are shut out of schools; if it names legume products or sets protein-quality rather than source norms, schools open. The Food Safety Law vote is now May 2027, not late 2026
conclusion_or_recommendation_affected: brief-policy timing and option 1; ch29.4 set-rules list; DMV-17; brief-investors 'watch October to November 2026'

line: Sugary-drink excise and plant milks: does the 2027 tax fall on sweetened soy and nut milks while dairy is exempt?
method: Read the decree implementing Law 66/2025/QH15 and the TCVN definition of 'nước giải khát'; audit sugar per 100 ml on the top 10 soy and nut milk SKUs; compute the price effect at 8% and 10%
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: If sweetened plant milks are taxed and dairy is not, ch23's finding that plant milk sells at or below dairy prices weakens from 2027 and plant-milk makers face reformulation pressure (a new buyer need for protein and texture in low-sugar drinks); if exempt, no change
conclusion_or_recommendation_affected: ch23; ch26 plant-milk buyers; TPP-05; play T10

line: Cost of 25 g of quality protein in a public meal: a costing and cost-effectiveness model for schools and canteens
method: Desk model combining the Part VI price ladder, school and canteen budgets (Decree 339, Hanoi subsidy, canteen floors), the guidance's energy and protein shares, composition data for zinc and iron, and published DIAAS values
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: If a fortified textured-soy or blended dish gives 25 g protein and adequate zinc below the cost of eggs or chicken, a public-meal product profile becomes a lead brief for UNICEF and provinces; if not, tofu stays the plant slot and school products are dropped
conclusion_or_recommendation_affected: TPP-04; ch25.3; brief-international 'separate two protein problems'

line: Child-nutrition equivalence test of plant and blended school dishes
method: Laboratory protein quality and phytate to zinc ratios for three or four candidate dishes (NIN or a university lab), plus a two-week acceptability trial in two to four schools
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: If plant or blended dishes match meat dishes on digestible protein and fortified zinc, NIN and UNICEF could name them in guidance; if zinc bioavailability is poor, confine plant products to adults and canteens
notes: Needs a partner such as NIN; cost not estimated.

line: Diet surveillance piggyback: analyse DQQ microdata now and add a plant-protein and chay module later
method: Download DQQ microdata for Viet Nam (Harvard Dataverse); tabulate pulses, processed meat and red meat by urban or rural, income, age and sex; propose a chay-day and tofu item to GAIN, Gallup and NIN
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: Gives a national base rate for plant-protein and processed-meat occasions: if processed meat is concentrated in young urban adults, hybrids target them; if pulses are a low-income rural food, plant protein carries a status penalty for positioning
conclusion_or_recommendation_affected: ch22 (chay days unmeasured); ch28 R3 (5% processed-meat assumption); DMV-01; DMV-09

line: Protein policy coherence audit across health, livestock, dairy and food-systems instruments
method: Tabulate the protein stance of every current instrument (Ten tips; Decision 3958; Decision 1982; livestock strategy per-person targets; dairy strategy 40 litres; Decision 300; expired Decision 1340) and compute the protein mix each implies
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: Would reframe the policy brief from 'no protein target' to 'health guidance already favours plant protein while sector targets hold meat per person near 60 kg'; changes which ministry to approach first

line: NAP-FST entry: can protein by source enter the food balance sheets, M&E framework and provincial plans?
method: Calls with the MAE FST Partnership secretariat, the national convenor (PHANO), the BDN country coordinator and the Dong Thap and Son La working groups
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: If the M&E framework and food balance sheets can take a protein-by-source indicator, Part V's national protein balance gains a government home; if not, it stays an NGO product
conclusion_or_recommendation_affected: brief-policy; ch20 robust move on a protein and feed balance; brief-international

line: Parent trust survey after the 2026 school pork case
method: Omnibus module (about 1,000 parents) on acceptance of tofu, legume, plant and blended protein dishes against certified meat, and willingness to pay for certified-safe protein
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: If parents prefer more plant dishes after the case, schools can be an early route for higher-protein chay; if they prefer certified meat, schools stay 'not first'
notes: Stated evidence only; pair with L01 revealed menus.

line: National bán trú count and meal prices
method: Written requests to MOET and five provincial DOETs; Decree 339 beneficiary lists
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: If national school lunches exceed 1 billion a year, the R4 route and the school channel rank rise

line: Shift-meal guidance and canteen menu audit
method: Obtain NIN's shift-meal guidance and the VGCL resolution; collect menus and protein specifications from three caterers
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: If guidance sets meat grams per meal, TPP-04 must meet it; if it names legumes, canteens have a plant slot like schools

line: Sodium and sugar audit of chay foods, plant analogues and plant drinks
method: Label audit of about 50 SKUs, then laboratory checks on a subset
result_that_would_change_a_conclusion: If chay foods and analogues exceed sodium benchmarks, health framing aligned with WHO and MOH fails and claims become a risk
